pages.text: Nine Chorus Pearls pack into a block, and it crafts back into pearls. With iron nuggets they also make Pearl Lanterns and Pearl Chains.
Sneak-use a Pearl Lantern to change its cage.
Shards pack into blocks, and the stonecutter cuts them into patterns.
Powered, a Lapse Block steps out of the world for three seconds and takes every Lapse Block touching it along.

$(item)Hollowstone$() comes from stone bricks sent by Waystone from the End to the Overworld, and has stairs, slabs and walls.$(br2)Three music discs come from leaving vanilla discs in a kiln: mellohi for four days, stal for five, far for seven. Each plays in any jukebox.
